d7.conclusion: No learned survival improvement; final policy dies earlier than RC. Infrastructure pilot only.

multicase.handoff: All three evaluations remain alive for 20 additional baseline decisions.
multicase.conclusion: Small seed-separated smoke test, not statistical generalisation evidence. Learned two-move retreat reaches observable safety, not proof enemies were defeated.

earlier_runs: rl-d7-smoke-v1/v2 and rl-multicase-smoke-v1 retained. Earlier D7 exploration once reached recovery; final corrected-update run does not. Do not substitute the earlier success for the final result.
limitations: Fresh model each invocation; saved weights are not production Lua exports.
Resource decisions are delegated to baseline RC, not learned as individual inventory actions.
Recovery is observable safety; bounded handoff survival is separately reported.
Fidelity certification covers original baseline trajectories, not every alternate-action trajectory.
